```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)



path <- "C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/臺東縣公車.csv"
data <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)


date1 <- as.Date(data$資料代表日期.yyyy.MM.dd.)
data$year <- year(date1)


data$票種 <- recode(data$持卡身分,
  "A" = "普通(含TPASS)",
  "B" = "學生",
  "C01" = "敬老優待",
  "C02" = "愛心優待",
  "C09" = "其他優待",
  "D" = "員工",
  "X" = "無法區別"
)



dir.create("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/112年至114年臺東縣市區客運搭車持卡身分長條圖", showWarnings = FALSE)

for(y in c(2023, 2024, 2025)){
  
  df <- data %>% filter(year == y)
  if(nrow(df) == 0) next
  

  card_table <- table(df$票種)

  card_table <- sort(card_table, decreasing = TRUE)
  

  percent <- round(prop.table(card_table)*100,1)
  
  roc <- y - 1911
  
  png(
    paste0("C:/Users/AVITA/Downloads/112年至114年臺東縣市區客運搭車持卡身分長條圖/",
           roc,"年臺東縣市區客運搭車持卡身分長條圖.png"),
    width = 8, height = 6, units = "in", res = 300
  )
  
  par(
    family = "yui",
    mar = c(4,2,6,2),
    xpd = NA
  )
  windowsFonts(yui = windowsFont("Microsoft JhengHei"))

  
  bp <- barplot(
    card_table,
    col = gray.colors(length(card_table), start=0.3, end=0.9),
    main = "",
    ylab = "",
    xlab = "",
    las = 1,
    cex.names = 0.9,
    yaxt = "n"
  )
  

  title(
    main = paste0(roc,"年臺東縣市區客運搭車持卡身分長條圖"),
    adj = 0.08
  )
  

  text(
    bp,
    card_table,
    labels = paste0(sprintf("%.1f", percent), "%"),
    pos = 3,
    cex = 0.9
  )
  
  dev.off()
}
```
